column1: # Partition table for the ESP32-P4 DAQ HAT (16 MB flash) with dual-OTA + relay staging.
# Two app slots (ota_0 / ota_1) + otadata enable safe A/B OTA with rollback.
# nvs holds calibration + settings + relay resume-state; phy_init is the RF calibration blob.
# staging holds exactly one full relay image (C6 or S3) at a time
